name: v10.22.14 Europe evidence tranche 1A - IS, NO, CH, SE, FI
notes: Official-source evidence for Iceland (IS), Norway (NO), Switzerland (CH), Sweden (SE) and Finland (FI). All five endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable immigration, residence and permit content. The tranche is intentionally limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Icelandic Directorate of Immigration official island.is page
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Icelandic Directorate of Immigration (Útlendingastofnun) publishes its official services on island.is under the /s/utlendingastofnun path. This supports a proposal that Iceland directly administers the relevant immigration services through the Directorate of Immigration.
immigration_assessment.review_notes: Independent review approved for IS: official source and jurisdiction relationship verified by local probe on 2026-07-18.

source_certification.evidence_notes: Locally probed on 2026-07-18 with status local_probe_passed. The Icelandic Directorate of Immigration page on island.is returned HTTPS 200 with content describing immigration services, status tracking, appointments, forms and fees. Keep the initial certification limited to the services explicitly described.
source_certification.review_notes: Independent review approved for IS: official source and jurisdiction relationship verified by local probe on 2026-07-18.
